purpose: Discover the smallest source-grounded guidance and executable verification with a measurable increase in complete independent deliveries per elapsed time/tokens; no product rollout decision before observations.

candidate_cohort.cohort_rule: All original-source requests fixed before the first worker; no cherry-picking or substitutions after dispatch. Historical public PR solutions must be excluded from isolated worker contexts.

A.label: Ordinary
A.intervention: Implement and self-test normally; no imposed checklist, Intentline plan, or Proofline check.

B.label: Concise checklist
B.intervention: Same worker first authors/uses one <=250-word checklist sourced from exact request, counting authoring inside the worker time. No Intentline or Proofline.

C.label: Checklist + Proofline
C.intervention: B plus same agent selects literal argv and may link source-cited R rows; opt-in check/status and #50 next-check hints; same agent assesses and may repair within same episode; no new reviewer model.

D.label: Intentline + Proofline
D.intervention: Same agent uses optional initial revision-1 single-S1 Intentline plan/export, Proofline import/check/status and optional explicit links. Unsupported exports fail without unmapped fallback; no reviewer/adopter/model controller.

model_proposal.host: macOS + authenticated Codex CLI (exact versions to be frozen after qualification)

budget_proposal.authoring_and_native_preflight_separate: measure and report; no free time or estimated tokens

worker_exposure.all: Complete captured issue title/body, isolated pre-implementation product tree and existing project tests, same finite tool permissions/time; no solution/other assignment/hidden oracle, control, retrospective result or network.
worker_exposure.B: Agent creates checklist <=250 words from original request; no preauthored evaluator checklist.
worker_exposure.C: Agent-owned checklist plus opted-in exact Proofline selected-argv check/status; links optional. #50 next-check hint is advisory and never semantic proof.
worker_exposure.D: Single-S1 initial revision-1 Intentline JSON export, optional explicit links and Proofline. Producer/import/setup and any guidance included in episode cost.

qualification_required: Validate each material oracle expectation and accepted alternatives against the exact full original source with independent reviewer; reject disputed/infeasible cases.
Qualify reference, independent correct alternative, independent defect and at least one green-existing-suite/missed-source-obligation control on supported native host.

Freeze exact source files/blobs, base commits/trees, independent oracle implementation/code hash, controls, default project-test argv, selected-check argv, model catalog/effort, host, tools, stage deadlines and order.
Qualify native worker/grader isolation, lack of solution/oracle leakage, producer S1 export and Proofline import/check/status readback with model-free disposable probes.
Obtain new explicit bounded model-spending authorization tied to that freeze. Prior approvals are not reusable.

first_stage_gate.scope: Run A on all four tasks before any B/C/D.
first_stage_gate.criterion: At least two independently confirmed material relevant source failures, including material omission despite green existing checks; workers' self-tests/check labels do not independently confirm failures.
first_stage_gate.otherwise: STOP_CEILING_OR_INSUFFICIENT_DISCRIMINATION; mark all 12 B/C/D NOT_EXECUTED; do not silently replace tasks or increase cohort.
first_stage_gate.when_passed: Run B/C/D for every predeclared task with balanced post-A rotation.

stop_rules: Host/model/effort/tool/producer/schema drift or unqualified native sandbox/oracle/controls
Leak of oracle, reference solution, sibling assignment or known outcomes into worker context
Unreconciled worker/grader/check lifecycle, absent executable evidence or campaign budget exhaustion
Independent oracle dispute or source-expectation conflict; mark affected outcomes UNKNOWN, halt before new dispatch as required
No silent retries, resume, substitution or cross-cohort pooling; leave all remaining slots NOT_EXECUTED
primary_outcome: Independently satisfactory completion of all original source obligations per assigned slot, regardless of ordinary green tests or advisory plan labels.

per_slot: native terminal event, status and exact argv/cwd/check receipts
blind oracle grade and disputed/unavailable assertions
source-linked #50 hint observed, chosen executable check, and material discovery or cosmetic effect
elapsed non-overlapping stages: preparation, plan, implementation, check, status/repair, grading; agent dispatch/tool counts
provider input/cached-input/output tokens (do not double count cached), actual billed cost only when observed, human interaction
cross_arm: independently correct/assigned; missing or blocked in same denominator
cost and elapsed time per independently correct (undefined if zero correct)
separate setup and study preparation overhead, never modeled as zero
paired task descriptions and small-N uncertainty; no general efficacy claim

boundaries: No production change, controller, extra AI reviewer, test generator or mandatory gate.
Only unqualified protocol and offline structural validation in Phase 1; native or live actions are NOT authorized.
No PR/merge publication by the study worker; this preparation PR is a user-authorized repository change distinct from experiment effects.
